summary: John B. Sanfilippo & Son, Inc. (JBSS) filed an 8-K announcing a special cash dividend of $1.05 per share and a regular annual cash dividend of $0.95 per share on both Common and Class A Common stock. The aggregate payment will return approximately $23.6 million to stockholders. Dividends are payable September 9, 2026, to holders of record August 17, 2026. The special dividend is a one-time capital return event. The annual dividend represents a $0.05 increase year-over-year. The filing does not mention any advisor or board recommendation beyond the dividend declaration. No structural complexities or regulatory clock are noted. What to watch: future capital allocation policies and whether special dividends become recurring.
